title: 2026 international maritime Document of Compliance and enforcement options QA

sources.title: UK ETS international maritime voyages consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS scope expansion: maritime sector

facts.source_fact: The main Authority Response removed the Document of Compliance requirement for domestic maritime expansion.
Domestic compliance is intended to be managed through UK ETS regulators using METS and the UK Emissions Trading Registry.
The international maritime consultation asks whether the Document of Compliance approach should change for international journeys.
The consultation asks whether a Document of Compliance should be reinstated for international scope.
The consultation notes other regional schemes can contain additional enforcement powers.
Examples cited include powers of expulsion.
The Authority seeks stakeholder views on whether such powers would be beneficial.
No port-ban or expulsion power is established by the consultation text itself.
International enforcement changes remain consultation questions rather than final UK ETS policy.
